pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Friendly Slime + any fishing rod. The exact rod is equipped and the slime starts waiting.

The rod keeps its enchantments, wear, name, and data. Choose Fish to find a nearby shore in its fixed area. Catches enter its bag. Five minutes without a catch makes it seek another spot. Lure shortens waiting; Luck of the Sea affects the native fishing loot table. Open water is required for treasure.

Each catch costs one stamina and wears the rod normally. Unbreaking reduces wear; Mending uses catch experience to repair the rod. Work Speed shortens fishing waits. Full cargo and broken rods request carrier support.
